sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that earlier the applicant was arrested and remanded to judicial custody which has been declared invalid by this Court and the applicant has already been released.
But, the applicant still apprehends his arrest.
The matter is still under investigation.
It is also submitted that the co-accused, having similar role has already been granted ad interim protection by this Court.

Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond and two sureties, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, the victim or/and any of the witness in the case.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
